adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts, line 97 shows `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);`. The parseRefreshTokenResponse function (in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts) returns the result of `schema.safeParse(response)` which is a Zod SafeParseResult object with shape `{ success: boolean, data?: T, error?: ZodError }`. This wrapper object is then passed directly to `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })` at line 98-101. This means the credential's key field will be set to `{ success: true, data: {...actual credentials...} }` instead of just the credential data. On the next read, the code expects the raw credential shape but gets this wrapper, causing a schema mismatch. This is a real bug.
